blocking_findings.description: prepare_window manually checks a partial CLOSE receipt and status-only UP completion instead of the existing execution_completed helper. Four invalid CLOSE receipts and one UP with explicit visual_gate_failure can reach PUBLIC_HOLDING_VERIFIED under synthetic successful registration while execution_completed rejects them.
blocking_findings.requested_fix: Use the unchanged strict execution_completed(Action(hand, close/up, fine), feedback) on EVERY recorded action, retaining existing strict statuses, clocks, endpoint and request bindings. Complete test fixtures with real schema. No relaxation of physical/vision/skill gates.

reviewed: All saved response replay endpoints and current visibility negative results
positive_boundaries: No actuation or model calls in these CPU checks
Current final frame, not prior positive, determines verification
Capture RGB-D bytes/clock/q/grip/render and actual same-hand CLOSE->UP chain are bound
limitations: Synthetic probes establish admission defects, not physical holding.
Saved responses are previous observations, not new physics or a learned completion policy.
Runtime integration remains separate and is not released by this report.
next: Parent accepted P2 and owns a separate frozen delta fix/review. Original6b remains unapproved. Prioritize independently released H09AB one-shot training; do not wait for H43 fix or H44.
